summary: Reference for TSet, the hashed unordered container of unique elements: creating, Add/Emplace/Append, iteration, Contains/Find/Index queries, Remove/Empty/Reset, Sort, slack management (Reserve, Shrink, Compact) and custom DefaultKeyFuncs hashing.
gotchas: Element order is not stable or guaranteed; sorting only holds until the next modification
Pointers to elements can be invalidated when storage reallocates
Standard allocators like FHeapAllocator/TInlineAllocator cannot be used; TSet needs set allocators
Do not modify an element's key in a way that changes its hash or equality

summary: Short reference for dynamic (serializable, reflection-aware) delegates: the DECLARE_DYNAMIC_DELEGATE and DECLARE_DYNAMIC_MULTICAST_DELEGATE macros, the BindDynamic/AddDynamic/RemoveDynamic helper macros, and Execute/ExecuteIfBound/IsBound.
gotchas: Dynamic delegates are slower than regular delegates
Check IsBound before Execute; executing an unbound delegate can corrupt memory
ExecuteIfBound may leave output parameters uninitialized

summary: Explains multicast delegates that bind many functions and fire them with Broadcast(): declaration macros, the Add/AddUObject/AddLambda/AddWeakLambda/AddSP/AddRaw family, and Remove/RemoveAll.
gotchas: Multicast delegate signatures cannot have return values
Broadcast execution order is undefined
RemoveAll does not remove Raw delegates not bound to an object pointer
AddRaw holds no reference; unsafe if the object is deleted

summary: Covers UObject basics: the UCLASS macro and Class Default Object, creating objects with NewObject and CreateDefaultSubobject, UHT header format with .generated.h and GENERATED_BODY, ticking via FTickableGameObject, and garbage-collection-based destruction (MarkAsGarbage, IsValid).
gotchas: UObjects have no constructor arguments and must have a default constructor; never use new/delete on them
Constructors should only set defaults and subobjects; put init logic in BeginPlay for Actors/Components
The .generated.h include must be the last #include
MarkPendingKill was replaced by MarkAsGarbage and no longer forces collection; use IsValid checks

summary: Guidance on when to move logic from Blueprints into C++ (speed, complexity) and tips for designing Blueprint-friendly C++ APIs: optional params, multiple outputs, deprecation metadata, ExpandEnumAsExecs, latent functions, function libraries, and pure/const nodes.
gotchas: Blueprint execution is slower than C++; move hot or high-frequency code to C++
To remove or change parameters, deprecate the old function and add a new one rather than editing it
Marking a function const removes its execution pins

summary: Explains the editor Asset Registry that indexes unloaded assets: querying FAssetData by class, path, package or tags, building FARFilter queries with GetAssets, AssetRegistrySearchable tags, and delegates for asynchronous discovery.
gotchas: Gathering is asynchronous; the list may be incomplete until OnFilesLoaded fires
Assets must be resaved before newly AssetRegistrySearchable properties appear in tags
GetAllAssets can be slow
In commandlets gathering is synchronous and LoadModule blocks

summary: Shows how to avoid loading everything at startup by using FSoftObjectPath/TSoftObjectPtr references, UObjectLibrary queries over unloaded asset data, and FStreamableManager SynchronousLoad/RequestAsyncLoad with a completion delegate.
gotchas: Hard UObject pointer properties load their assets with the owner, which can load everything at startup
SynchronousLoad can stall the main thread
StreamableManager releases its hard references after the delegate fires; keep your own reference to keep assets alive

summary: Describes experimental async (multithreaded) loading for opening levels in the editor: enabling the Clang instrumentation build and race detection, turning it on by default in DefaultEngine.ini, and loader-safe coding practices.
gotchas: Experimental; race conditions may occur
Race detection recommends 24-32 GB free memory and runs 10-20x slower
Instrumentation compiler is Clang-based; MSVC-only code may need fixes
Avoid loader flushes, UI or transaction calls and global state in code called by the loader

summary: How to pass launch arguments to the editor or a packaged game (command line, Editor Preferences Additional Launch Parameters, shortcuts, UECommandLine.txt), URL map parameters, parsing custom flags and key-value pairs with FParse, and -CmdLineFile.
gotchas: Editor Additional Launch Parameters only apply to Play in Standalone Game
Separate-server launch parameters require Launch Separate Server and Run Under One Process disabled
Maps outside the Maps directory need a full path with the .umap extension
Custom arguments are ignored unless your code parses them

summary: Explains console variables and commands in C++: registering CVars with TAutoConsoleVariable or IConsoleManager, reading values, tracking changes via sinks or callbacks, loading from ConsoleVariables.ini or [SystemSettings], -ExecCmds, and the SetBy priority order.
gotchas: Avoid the old Exec interface; register through the console manager
OnChanged callbacks can deadlock or fire during init/serialization; prefer polling or sinks
Lower-priority sources cannot override a higher SetBy priority (e.g. command line beats device profile)
-ExecCmds syntax omits the = used in ini files

summary: How to keep assets loading after renaming C++ classes, structs, enums, functions, properties or packages by adding [CoreRedirects] entries (ClassRedirects, PropertyRedirects, etc.) to DefaultEngine.ini, including MatchSubstring and debugging.
gotchas: Class and struct names drop the A/U/F prefix; enum names keep it
MatchSubstring slows startup; use temporarily, resave assets, then remove it
Renaming without a redirect loses saved data
Pre-4.16 redirect formats are still supported but should not be copied

summary: Explains UDataAsset and UPrimaryDataAsset: creating a C++ data asset class, making instances via Content Browser Miscellaneous > Data Asset, PrimaryAssetType/GetPrimaryAssetId rules for Asset Manager loading, and when to prefer Data Only Blueprints.
gotchas: For data inheritance or complex hierarchies use Data Only Blueprints instead of Data Asset instances
PrimaryAssetType comes from the first native class or the highest Blueprint class in the hierarchy unless GetPrimaryAssetId is overridden
Project must be built before the class appears in the Data Asset picker

summary: Covers the Data Validation plugin: validating assets, folders or the whole project from the Content Browser or Tools > Validate Data, running the DataValidation commandlet in CI, and writing rules via IsDataValid overrides or UEditorValidatorBase subclasses in C++, Blueprint or Python.
gotchas: Commandlet runs only C++ validation rules by default
Python validators must register themselves with UEditorValidatorSubsystem.AddValidator
ValidateLoadedAsset must call AssetPasses or AssetFails on every path
Validation runs on asset save by default

summary: Explains auto-instanced subsystems with managed lifetimes (Engine, Editor, GameInstance, LocalPlayer), their Initialize/Deinitialize timing, access from C++, Blueprint nodes and Python (unreal.get_editor_subsystem), with a GameInstance stats subsystem example.
gotchas: Page still describes Python as experimental
Subsystem is garbage-collected after Deinitialize once references are dropped

summary: Compares ways to reference assets in C++: hard UPROPERTY references, ConstructorHelpers::FObjectFinder in constructors, soft TSoftObjectPtr/TSoftClassPtr with manual loading, and runtime FindObject/LoadObject/LoadClass by path.
gotchas: FObjectFinder sets the property to nullptr if the asset is missing; later access can crash
Hard references load all referenced assets with the owner and can balloon memory
LoadObject/StaticLoadObject are synchronous and can cause frame spikes
TSoftObjectPtr requires you to load the asset manually

summary: Overview of FName, FText and FString: what each is for, Printf/UE_LOG formatting, a conversion table between them and to/from int32/float, and using the TEXT() macro for literals.
gotchas: FNames are case-insensitive and immutable; FString to FName is lossy
FText to FString can be lossy for some languages; no direct FText to FName
Use FText for all user-facing text so it can be localized
Literals without TEXT() are ANSI and need conversion

summary: Describes the UE::Tasks job system for async gameplay code: Launch with priorities, FTask/TTask results and waiting, prerequisites for dependency graphs, nested tasks with AddNested, FPipe for serialized access, FTaskEvent signaling, and Unreal Insights tracing.
gotchas: Busy-waiting deprecated since 5.5, replaced by oversubscription with standby threads
Waiting limits scalability; prefer prerequisites
AddNested asserts if called outside a task
Pipes are non-copyable/non-movable and a task cannot be in multiple pipes

summary: Explains engine version compatibility (FEngineVersion, Build.version, UpdateLocalVersion), engine-level and FGuid custom object versioning, and writing version-aware Serialize overrides with FArchive UEVer/CustomVer.
gotchas: Assets saved in a newer engine version do not load; references become null and resaving loses them
Changelist 0 builds are treated as compatible with everything but cause cook warnings
IsLicenseeVersion=1 disables Hot Reload

summary: Hub page linking to TArray, TMap, TSet and (oddly) Class Specifiers pages.

Main delegates page: the DECLARE_DELEGATE macro family by signature, UDELEGATE specifiers, Bind/BindUObject/BindSP/BindLambda/BindRaw/BindStatic, payload data, and Execute/ExecuteIfBound with a worked FLogWriter example.
gotchas: Pass delegates by reference; passing by value allocates on the heap
Calling Execute on an unbound delegate triggers an assertion
Dynamic delegates do not support payload variables
Delegate declarations cannot be inside a function body

summary: Epic's C++ coding standard: type prefixes (U/A/S/I/F/E/T, b for bools), naming, const correctness, C++20 feature rules (auto, lambdas and captures, enum class, nullptr), formatting, namespaces, include hygiene, API design and platform-specific code.
gotchas: UHT requires correct type prefixes
Avoid auto except for lambdas, verbose iterators and templates; no structured bindings
Use explicit lambda captures; captured UObject pointers are invisible to GC
Enums exposed to Blueprints must be uint8-based; namespaces not supported for UCLASS/USTRUCT

summary: Reference for declaring gameplay classes: header/source layout, UCLASS syntax with the full table of class specifiers and class metadata, constructors and FObjectInitializer, ConstructorHelpers FObjectFinder/FClassFinder, and creating components with CreateDefaultSubobject.
gotchas: Metadata exists only in the editor; do not use it in game logic
Store every constructor-created component in a UPROPERTY so it is GC-tracked
Hardcoded asset references are brittle; prefer Blueprint-configured properties
Inline constructors in headers need the CustomConstructor specifier

summary: Full reference of meta=() and UMETA tags for classes, enums, interfaces, structs, functions and properties, e.g. DisplayName, ClampMin/ClampMax, EditCondition, ExposeOnSpawn, WorldContext, ExpandEnumAsExecs, AutoCreateRefTerm and DeterminesOutputType.
gotchas: Metadata exists only in the editor; game logic must not read it
HidePin and InternalUseParam can hide only one parameter per function
CustomStructureParam requires CustomThunk and a custom exec function
GetByRef and NoGetter only work with Sparse Class Data

summary: Compares UObject pointer types (raw T*, TObjectPtr, TSoftObjectPtr, TWeakObjectPtr, TStrongObjectPtr, deprecated TLazyObjectPtr) by UPROPERTY support, GC impact, on-demand loading, serialization and networking, with a quick guide for which to use.
gotchas: TObjectPtr is only GC-safe when marked UPROPERTY
TLazyObjectPtr is deprecated; use TSoftObjectPtr
TWeakObjectPtr cannot be a TMap key or TSet element; use TObjectKey
Do not access UObjects via TObjectPtr from worker threads; pin a TWeakObjectPtr instead

summary: Hub page listing Unreal architecture topics: async asset and level loading, console variables, core redirects, data assets, data validation, modules, referencing assets, asset registry, strings, subsystems, tasks, config files, command-line arguments and asset versioning.

Short overview of gameplay C++ architecture: classes, structs and interfaces made visible to the engine through UCLASS, UFUNCTION, UPROPERTY, USTRUCT, UINTERFACE and UPARAM macros, with links to the reflection reference pages.
Hub overview of the reflection system linking Objects, Properties, Structs, TSubclassOf, Interfaces, Metadata Specifiers, UFunctions and the Smart Pointer Library pages.
Hub page for C++ development setup linking Visual Studio, VS Code, Xcode, Rider setup, Live Coding, managing game code, the C++ Class Wizard, compiling projects and programming tools.

Tour of the Level Editor layout: menu bar, main toolbar (modes, Create/Blueprints/Cinematics, Play controls, Platforms), viewport toolbar, viewport navigation and transform shortcuts, Content Drawer, bottom toolbar (Output Log, console/Python, Live Coding), Outliner and Details panel.
gotchas: Live Coding compiler button only appears in C++ projects
Content Drawer auto-minimizes on focus loss unless docked (Ctrl+Space opens it)
